And Counsel for Applicant :- Ashish Raman Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard SriAshish Raman Mishra the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri J.L. Maurya,
the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing Case Crime No.397 of 1999 under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120B IPC, Police Station Rudauli, District Barabanki/Ayodhya.

sentences.text: 3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 20.06.1999 alleging that the informant had made investments in Rapti Group of Companies but thereafter the Company's office was closed.

4. Learned A.G.A. has raised a preliminary objection against the maintainability of the application and he has pointed out that the charge-sheet was submitted in the year 2007, the Court took Prem Garg vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2021860/
1 cognizance of the case and when the applicant did not appear inspite of issuance of non bailable warrant, proclamation under Section 82/83 Cr.P.C. was initiated against the applicant and a cash reward has been declared for arrest of the applicant on 19.10.2005.

entities.text: Prem Garg vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the A.G.A. has also submitted that the applicant has been declared proclaimed offender in two other cases.
He has submitted that the applicant is habitual of avoiding process of the Court, and this dis-entitles for grant of pre-arrest bail to him.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view nature of allegations against the accused-applicant, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts do not warrant exercise of discretion of this court by granting pre-arrest bail to the applicant.
7. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is rejected.
However, in case the applicant files a bail application, the same shall be considered and decided, without being influenced by rejection of this anticipatory bail application.
